label: Pregnant belly touched / kissed / talked to by kids
group_title: Pregnant belly touched by kids additions (Oct 2026)
description: Family-friendly films and TV episodes where a visibly pregnant woman has her belly kissed, touched, listened to or talked to by children (own children, siblings or other kids). Strictly wholesome, non-sexual scenes; every record names the episode (season/episode) where the scene occurs and has a verified free legal watch link.

category_labels.belly-kissed: Pregnant belly kissed / touched by kids

records.title: Peppa Pig — Mummy Rabbit's Bump
records.meta: Children's animated TV series · United Kingdom · English
records.mechanism: Child listens to a pregnant mother's belly (wholesome)
records.summary: Rebecca and Richard Rabbit arrive with the news that their mummy has a bump in her tummy. Mummy Rabbit (visibly pregnant) invites Peppa to listen; Peppa rests her head on Mummy Rabbit's tummy, hears the baby's heartbeat and feels it kick, and the children then pick names (Rosie / Robbie) before the twins are born.
records.character: Mummy Rabbit (pregnant) · Peppa Pig (child) · Rebecca and Richard Rabbit (her children) · George, Suzy Sheep, Pedro Pony

episodes.gist: Peppa puts her head on pregnant Mummy Rabbit's tummy to hear the baby, which kicks.

records.provenance: Pregnant-belly-touched-by-kids research pass, 1 Oct 2026 (wholesome family content only)
records.note: Peppa is a family friend, not Mummy Rabbit's own child; Mummy Rabbit's own children Rebecca and Richard are present but do not touch her tummy on screen.
